items.title: 11.7 Alkenes ki banawat aur reactivity (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu introduction to topic 11.7, printed page 256.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Kitab is heading ke foran baad 11.7.1 shuru karti hai. Alkenes ki reactivity carbon-carbon double bond ki banawat (structure) se aati hai. Is hisse mein ethene ki banawat (11.7.1), π bond ki reactivity, carbocation ki stability aur alkyl groups ka inductive effect (11.7.2), aur electron kheenchne wala inductive effect (11.7.3) parhenge.

blocks.prompt: Stability mein alkane aur alkene mein kya farq hai (Quick Check 11.5a)?
blocks.explanation: Alkane mein sirf mazboot sigma bonds hain, is liye woh zyada tar reagents ke saath stable rehta hai. Alkene mein is ke ilawa aik π bond bhi hai jis ke electrons bond ki lakeer ke oopar neeche hain, dheele pakre hote hain aur electrophiles ke hamle ke liye khule hain. Is liye alkene kam stable aur kahin zyada reactive hai.

items: Alkene ki reactivity C=C ki banawat se aati hai: kamzor, khula π bond aur carbocations ke zariye reactions (11.7.1 se 11.7.3).
